{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the sales data
sales_df = pd.read_csv('/home/musel/Github/research_agent/data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to numeric, coercing errors to NaN
sales_df['revenue'] = pd.to_numeric(sales_df['revenue'], errors='coerce')

# Check for any invalid revenue values
invalid_revenue = sales_df[sales_df['revenue'].isnull()]

# Confirm the count of completed orders
completed_orders = sales_df[sales_df['status'] == 'completed'].shape[0]

# Check if the invalid revenue rows are among completed orders
invalid_completed = invalid_revenue[invalid_revenue['status'] == 'completed']

# Print results
completed_orders, invalid_completed.shape[0]"}
